Values | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content As a fourth-generation North Dakotan, I am proud to bring the values of our great state to Congress. North Dakotans are hardworking, independent, and deeply connected to their faith, families, and communities. Growing up the youngest of eight children and the daughter of hardworking, faith-filled conservative parents was an incredible blessing. I learned the values of family, faith in God, and service to others.    As a Christian, wife, and mother, I believe in the sanctity of life and am committed to protecting the unborn. I stand firm in defending our constitutional rights, including the Second Amendment, which ensures law-abiding citizens can responsibly own guns and exercise their freedoms.    I will always fight for policies that uphold North Dakota’s legacy of strong families, vibrant communities, and economic opportunity, while opposing efforts of government overreach that threatens our way of life. Serving the people of North Dakota is my greatest honor, and I am committed to preserving our values for generations to come.    More on Values Fedorchak on Fox Business: “It’s common sense requiring American voters to have an ID to vote in American elections” June 12, 2026 In The News Washington, D.C. Health | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content Every North Dakotan should have access to affordable, high-quality health care, including those living in rural areas. Growing up in North Dakota, I’ve seen firsthand the challenges families face, from traveling long distances to access care to dealing with the rising costs of health care services.   I believe in patient-centered solutions that lower costs, expand access, improve outcomes and strengthen rural health care systems by slashing government bureaucracy. Health care decisions should be made by doctors and patients in North Dakota, not in Washington, D.C. We need to empower families to live the life they wish, in the communities they choose, by supporting our Critical Access Hospitals, Community Health Centers, and emergency medical services. I am committed to advancing policies that preserve freedom, improve access, and helps rural communities keep the healthcare services they need to thrive.   More on Health Fedorchak, Carter introduce bipartisan legislation to strengthen rural health offices nationwide March 17, 2026 Press Release Washington, D.C. — Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) and Congressman Troy Carter Sr. Issues : Health Fedorchak votes to complete annual appropriations through regular order January 22, 2026 Press Release Washington, D.C. — Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) today voted for the final FY26 funding package that completes the appropriations process through regular order.  If enacted into law, FY26 will mark the first time in decades that Congress has funded the federal government through all 12 appropriations bills without reverting to a year-long continuing resolution.   Issues : National Defense and Security Budget and Economy Health Fedorchak statement on discharge petition to extend Obamacare Enhanced Premium Tax Credits January 8, 2026 Press Release Washington, D.C. — Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) released the following statement after voting against a Democrat-led discharge petition to advance a three-year extension of the COVID-era Obamacare Enhanced Premium Tax Credits. Veterans | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content Honoring our veterans and supporting our military are top priorities. As the wife of a Navy veteran and daughter of an Army veteran, I understand the sacrifices our service members and their families make to protect our freedoms. We must maintain a strong, well-equipped military to face global challenges and defend our way of life.   When veterans return home, they deserve the benefits that they’ve rightfully earned through their service to our nation. This includes access to high-quality health care, education, and job opportunities, as well as any support they may need to successfully transition to civilian life. Our nation owes a profound debt of gratitude to those who have served, and I will work to uphold the promises made to our heroes and their families.   More on Veterans Fedorchak supports legislation honoring veterans and Gold Star families ahead of Memorial Day May 22, 2026 Press Release Washington, D.C. – Ahead of Memorial Day, Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) voted in support of two pieces of legislation aimed at honoring America’s veterans, protecting their constitutional rights, and strengthening support for Gold Star families and veterans living with severe service-connected disabilities Issues : Veterans Fedorchak supports first FY27 appropriations bill to strengthen veterans’ care and military readiness May 15, 2026 Press Release Washington, D.C. – Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) today voted in support of the Fiscal Year 2027 Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act , the first FY27 appropriations bill passed by the House this Congress. Agriculture | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content Agriculture is a top industry in our state, and North Dakota farmers work tirelessly to feed and fuel the world despite our short growing season and frequent challenges like droughts, floods, and uncertain market conditions. As someone who grew up spending summers on my family’s farm, I have a deep appreciation for the hard work, resilience, and innovation of our farmers and ranchers.    Agriculture is the backbone of our economy and our communities. I will support policies that help mitigate risk, expand market opportunities, and reduce burdensome regulations. This means improving the Farm Bill to make programs more farmer friendly and strengthening crop insurance. I will also support agriculture technology development in our state, from precision agriculture tools to autonomous systems and much more. Finally, our producers need fair trade practices that allow them to compete in the global economy, and I am working with President Trump and his team to keep agriculture front of mind in US trade policy.   More on Agriculture Fedorchak: Foreign beef imports send the wrong signal to North Dakota ranchers August 21, 2026 Press Release Bismarck, ND  – Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) released the following statement after the Trump administration announced it will temporarily allow up to 300,000 metric tons of ground beef to be imported into the United States without the higher out-of-quota tariff:   Issues : Agriculture Following Fedorchak push, USDA provides drought flexibility for North Dakota producers August 17, 2026 Press Release Fargo, ND — Following Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak’s (R-ND) request for greater flexibility for North Dakota farmers and ranchers facing severe drought, the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) has confirmed that producers may request an extension to the 15-day timeframe for removing hay bales on Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) lands by contacting their local county FSA office. Tribal Relations | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content North Dakota shares geography with five sovereign Tribal Nations, each with a unique history, culture, and government. As federally recognized tribes, they have a nation-to-nation relationship with the United States, and our federal government must uphold its trust and treaty responsibilities. I am committed to strengthening government-to-government relationships and building partnerships that respect tribal sovereignty and promote the well-being of Native communities. This includes advocating for policies that improve access to quality education, healthcare, and public safety services. My approach is rooted in open communication, collaboration, and a sincere commitment to listening and working alongside tribal leaders to advance meaningful solutions. Budget and Economy | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content The reckless spending habits in Washington are a huge drag on our economy and a real curse for future generations. No hardworking North Dakotan would run up massive credit card debt to buy a new house, expensive clothes, fancy trips, and a new car—only to leave the bill for their kids to pay. But that’s exactly what the federal government is doing. Last year alone, our nation spent roughly $70,000 every second, piling on debt that will eventually fall on the shoulders of our children and grandchildren.   North Dakotans understand the importance of living within their means, and it’s time Washington does the same. I am supporting efforts to balance the budget, root out waste, fraud, and abuse, and bring greater transparency to federal spending. This problem has been ignored for far too long. Congress has failed for decades to follow a disciplined, balanced budgeting process . I will work with my colleagues to change that record and put us on a course to erase the deficit and debt.    More on Budget and Economy Fedorchak supports legislation to strengthen oversight of federal child care programs June 3, 2026 Press Release Washington, D.C. – Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) voted in support of H.R. 7726, the Stop Child Care Scams Act of 2026 , legislation to strengthen oversight of federal child care assistanceprograms, crack down on fraud, and verify taxpayer dollars are used to support children and working families.   Issues : Budget and Economy Second Trump Accounts Sign Up event to be held in Fargo May 20, 2026 Press Release Washington, D.C. Energy and Environment | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content I’m focused on energy affordability, reliability, sustainability, and security. Energy is the foundation of a strong economy and a high quality of life—for North Dakotans and people around the world. I firmly believe that nothing is truly sustainable if it isn’t affordable and reliable.   As a member of the Energy and Commerce Committee, I am committed to advancing policies that unleash America’s energy production, strengthen our national security, lower costs, and support economic growth. I will work with the Trump administration and my colleagues in Congress to expand domestic energy production, promote innovation, and ensure American energy remains affordable and accessible while improving environmental stewardship.   North Dakotans have always understood the importance of protecting the land, water, and resources that sustain us. I’ll always work to support policies that preserve our environment, create jobs, and allow North Dakota to feed and fuel America for generations to come.   More on Energy and Environment Fedorchak, NDSU: Year-round E15 would strengthen North Dakota’s $7.3 billion corn industry, lower fuel costs August 17, 2026 Press Release Fargo, ND — Congresswoman Julie Fedorchak (R-ND) today joined North Dakota State University economist David Ripplinger, farmers, ethanol producers, fuel retailers, livestock interests, and industry leaders to discuss the impact of year-round E15 and biofuels policy on North Dakota agriculture. A joint study from the biofuels and corn industry estimates year-round E15 will add $25.8 billion to the U.S. economy and create 128,000 jobs. National Defense and Security | Representative Julie Fedorchak Skip to main content America’s military is the backbone of our national security, protecting our families and safeguarding our freedoms. A strong, well-equipped force is essential to defending against threats at home and abroad. North Dakota plays a critical role in this mission, home to two Air Force bases in Grand Forks and Minot, a Space Force station in Cavalier, and the nationally renowned North Dakota National Guard and Air Guard. These installations are at the forefront of our nation’s nuclear deterrence, intelligence gathering, and defense operations. In Congress, my priority is supporting our servicemen and women with the tools, training, and resources they need to be safe, strong and effective defending our nation at home and abroad. At the same time, we must stand firm with our allies. A secure Israel means a more secure America, and my commitment to supporting Israel’s safety and stability is unwavering. Meanwhile, the U.S. faces a diverse range of threats. Russia’s war in Ukraine, China’s aggressive push towards increasing ballistic stockpiles, and Iran’s relentless advancement towards nuclearization directly threaten the security of every American. We must be prepared at all times and under any circumstance to defeat any adversary that terrorizes people around the world.
